title: Tiny, cute castle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground / hill -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='42' ry='10' fill='#2e7d32'/>
  <!-- main castle body -->
  <rect x='30' y='45' width='40' height='38' rx='4' fill='#c9a0dc'/>
  <!-- body shading right side -->
  <rect x='58' y='45' width='12' height='38' rx='4' fill='#a87cc2'/>
  <!-- left tower -->
  <rect x='18' y='35' width='16' height='48' rx='4' fill='#f7c873'/>
  <!-- left tower shading -->
  <rect x='28' y='35' width='6' height='48' rx='3' fill='#d9a847'/>
  <!-- right tower -->
  <rect x='66' y='35' width='16' height='48' rx='4' fill='#f7c873'/>
  <!-- right tower shading -->
  <rect x='76' y='35' width='6' height='48' rx='3' fill='#d9a847'/>
  <!-- left tower roof -->
  <polygon points='16,35 26,14 36,35' fill='#ef5350'/>
  <!-- right tower roof -->
  <polygon points='64,35 74,14 84,35' fill='#ef5350'/>
  <!-- center roof -->
  <polygon points='28,45 50,26 72,45' fill='#7e57c2'/>
  <!-- center roof shading -->
  <polygon points='50,26 72,45 50,45' fill='#5e35b1'/>
  <!-- flags -->
  <line x1='26' y1='14' x2='26' y2='8' stroke='#ffe082' stroke-width='2'/>
  <polygon points='26,8 34,11 26,14' fill='#4dd0e1'/>
  <line x1='74' y1='14' x2='74' y2='8' stroke='#ffe082' stroke-width='2'/>
  <polygon points='74,8 82,11 74,14' fill='#4dd0e1'/>
  <!-- door -->
  <path d='M44,83 L44,64 Q50,56 56,64 L56,83 Z' fill='#6d4c41'/>
  <!-- door knob -->
  <circle cx='53' cy='74' r='2' fill='#ffd54f'/>
  <!-- windows main body -->
  <rect x='36' y='52' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#4dd0e1'/>
  <rect x='58' y='52' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#4dd0e1'/>
  <!-- windows left tower -->
  <rect x='22' y='44' width='6' height='7' rx='2' fill='#4dd0e1'/>
  <!-- windows right tower -->
  <rect x='72' y='44' width='6' height='7' rx='2' fill='#4dd0e1'/>
  <!-- crenellations on towers -->
  <rect x='18' y='31' width='4' height='5' fill='#f7c873'/>
  <rect x='26' y='31' width='4' height='5' fill='#f7c873'/>
  <rect x='66' y='31' width='4' height='5' fill='#f7c873'/>
  <rect x='74' y='31' width='4' height='5' fill='#f7c873'/>
  <!-- little heart above castle -->
  <path d='M50,20 C48,16 42,16 42,21 C42,26 50,30 50,30 C50,30 58,26 58,21 C58,16 52,16 50,20 Z' fill='#ff80ab'/>
</svg>
